_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE shape-only fixture for the api-error-envelope suite — it documents the SHAPE a conforming runner emits (top-level keys + per-case `cases[]` entries), NOT golden values. Get the real headline from your own `skillevaluation run ./examples/api-error-envelope`: the without-skill arm omits request_id / doesn't nest under `error`; the with-skill arm emits the exact envelope. turns=1 / tool_calls=0 because the default `llm` adapter is single-shot.

cases._note: Without-skill returns a flat {"error": "User not found"} with no request_id; with-skill returns {"error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "...", "request_id": "..."}}.
Without-skill omits request_id and/or uses a non-house code; with-skill emits the VALIDATION_ERROR envelope.
Without-skill can't know the UNAUTHORIZED code + request_id requirement; with-skill emits the envelope.
Without-skill returns a bare 429 message; with-skill emits the RATE_LIMITED envelope.
Both arms answer '404' in plain prose; the skill correctly does not over-activate the envelope on a factual question.
